role_categories.label: Manufacturing
role_categories.description: A company that made the physical article or a part of it, other than the disc pressing itself: general manufacture, tape duplication, and print work.

role_categories.label: Mastering
role_categories.description: A company that mastered the audio, as distinct from the fabrication of a physical transfer master.

role_categories.label: Transfer master
role_categories.description: A company that cut, mastered, or plated the physical master the copies are made from: a lacquer, a glass master, or a stamper.

role_categories.label: Pressing
role_categories.description: A plant that pressed the discs.

role_categories.label: Distribution
role_categories.description: A company that moved the article to a market.

role_categories.label: Marketing
role_categories.description: A company that marketed the release.

role_categories.label: Rights
role_categories.description: A company holding or licensing a right in the release: copyright, phonographic copyright, publishing, licensing, or the record company of record.

role_categories.label: Recording facility
role_categories.description: A facility or company where the audio was captured or worked on before mastering: recording, engineering, mixing, editing, and production.

role_categories.label: Other
role_categories.description: A company relationship the vocabulary does not model separately; the raw role is preserved on the item.
